description: The holographic memory as infrastructure: recall is the matrix-vector multiply Y = WX executed as one pass over a fixed-size structure (per-query cost O(N^2), independent of library size P; crossover at P = N exact; measured 19.5x wall-clock vs brute-force search at P=1024, N=64, same content returned), and the hologram is an error-correcting code characterized as physical-error-rate -> logical-error-rate curves (zero logical errors out to 75% erasure at sigma=0; honest shatter threshold when overloaded at sigma=0.30, P=16 > P90=4). The three-titans mapping holds as measured properties: Schrodinger (interference, not lookup), Heisenberg (non-orthogonal patterns cannot be simultaneously perfectly recalled -- crosstalk and drift are theorems), Dirac (the inner product is computed between conjugate ket and bra). Honest limits: the energy argument is analytic (op counts, traffic), not hardware-measured; brute force finds the same winner (the comparison is cost structure); code curves are load-dependent. Stdlib-only Python, seeded, classical throughout, 8/8 tests pass.
title: Hologram-Compute
